title: My Soul Longs for the Courts of the Lord

questions.question: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:1 (ESV): "How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of hosts!"

questions.question: My soul longs, yes, faints for the courts of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:2 (ESV): "My soul longs, yes, faints for the courts of the Lord;"

questions.question: My heart and flesh sing for joy to the living what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:2 (ESV): "my heart and flesh sing for joy to the living God."

questions.question: Even the sparrow finds a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:3 (ESV): "...where she may lay her young,"

questions.question: Blessed are those who dwell in your house, ever singing your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:4 (ESV): "Blessed are those who dwell in your house, ever singing your praise!"

questions.question: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, in whose heart are the highways to where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:5 (ESV): "...in whose heart are the highways to Zion."

questions.question: As they go through the Valley of Baca they make it a place of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:6 (ESV): "As they go through the Valley of Baca they make it a place of springs;"

questions.question: They go from strength to strength; each one appears before God in where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:7 (ESV): "...each one appears before God in Zion."

questions.question: Behold our shield, O God; look on the face of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:9 (ESV): "Behold our shield, O God; look on the face of your anointed!"

questions.question: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:10 (ESV): "For a day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere."

questions.question: I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:10 (ESV): "...than dwell in the tents of wickedness."

questions.question: For the Lord God is a sun and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:11 (ESV): "For the Lord God is a sun and shield;"

questions.question: The Lord bestows favor and honor. No good thing does he withhold from those who walk how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:11 (ESV): "...No good thing does he withhold from those who walk uprightly."

questions.question: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the one who trusts in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:12 (ESV): "O Lord of hosts, blessed is the one who trusts in you!"

questions.question: What happens to the early rain in the Valley of Baca?
questions.explanation: Psalm 84:6 (ESV): "...the early rain also covers it with pools."

key_verse_text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of wickedness.
